title: 5 September 1961: Live: Cavern Club, Liverpool (lunchtime)
content:
This was The Beatles’ 33rd lunchtime performance at the Cavern Club on Mathew Street, Liverpool.

The group had been booked to perform in the evening too, and adverts appeared in the local press. However, the booking was rearranged for the following night instead.

The Beatles’ lunchtime shows typically lasted from 12-2pm. This was their 46th known appearance overall, including evening shows, at the soon-to-be-famous cellar venue.

Although the precise number of their Cavern performances is not known, The Beatles played at least 155 lunchtime and 125 evening shows between 9 February 1961 and 3 August 1963.
